zh.title: 用固定刀具加工竹条
zh.question: 人物拉动竹条经过固定刀刃的整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手对竹条的抓持、拉动与身体协调，允许不同的抓持位置和动作幅度。
zh.contact: 竹条相对固定刀刃的运动应与手的拉动相联系，刀具与支架保持可解释的支撑关系。
zh.object: 若竹条表面被削薄或出现竹屑，这些变化应与经过刀刃的部位相对应。
zh.aftermath: 若竹屑或竹条末端移动、掉落，观察其与支架和地面的关系，不要求一定产生可见竹屑。
scores: 人体、竹条、刀具和支撑的可见过程整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有拉动竹条经过刀具。
可辨认加工尝试，但手的拉动、竹条运动与刀刃作用严重不符。
拉动或刀具作用部分合理，同时存在影响加工过程的明显异常。
主要拉动、接触和竹条反应合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际加工已呈现，人体、竹条、固定刀具和可见后续变化协调，没有明显异常。
zh.unknown: 仅摆放材料，或竹条与刀刃的实际交互始终不可见时选择无法判断。

en.title: Work a bamboo strip against a fixed blade
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person pulls a bamboo strip across a fixed blade?
en.body: Consider both hands’ grip and pull and their coordination with the body. Grip positions and motion ranges may vary.
en.contact: The strip’s motion relative to the fixed edge should relate to the pull, while the tool remains plausibly supported by its stand.
en.object: Any visible thinning or shavings should correspond to the part of the strip passing the edge.
en.aftermath: If shavings or the end of the strip move or fall, consider their relation to the stand and ground. Visible shavings are not required.
scores: The visible person, strip, blade, and support behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no pulling across the blade.
A working attempt is recognizable, but the pull, strip motion, and blade action seriously disagree.
Some pulling or blade action is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the work.
The main pull, contact, and strip response are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual working is shown, and the person, strip, fixed blade, and visible subsequent changes are coherent without obvious anomalies.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if materials are only positioned or the actual strip–blade interaction is never visible.

zh.title: 用宽刃刀切竹竿
zh.question: 人物支撑竖立竹竿并用宽刃刀切割的整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察支撑竹竿与持刀手的配合、手臂运动和蹲姿平衡，不要求固定挥刀方式。
zh.contact: 刀刃的运动及其与竹竿的接触应与手臂动作相对应，竹竿的支撑应可解释。
zh.object: 若竹竿出现切痕、弯曲或分离，应与刀刃作用位置及过程相联系，不要求一次切断。
zh.aftermath: 若竹段或碎屑落下，观察其与地板及其他竹段的接触，不要求产生碎屑。
scores: 人体、刀、竹竿和支撑的可见过程整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有切割。
可辨认切割尝试，但刀的作用与竹竿关键反应严重不符。
支撑、用刀或竹竿变化部分合理，同时有影响切割的明显异常。
主要切割及人体、刀和竹竿反应合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际切割已呈现，人体、刀、竹竿及可见后续变化协调，没有明显异常。
zh.unknown: 仅支撑竹竿或准备工具，或刀刃与竹竿的实际交互始终不可见时选择无法判断。

en.title: Cut an upright bamboo stalk with a broad blade
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person supports an upright bamboo stalk and cuts it with a broad blade?
en.body: Consider coordination between the supporting and tool hands, arm motion, and balance while crouching. No fixed stroke is required.
en.contact: Blade motion and contact with the stalk should correspond to the arm action, with interpretable support of the stalk.
en.object: Any visible cut, bending, or separation should relate to the position and action of the blade. Cutting through in one stroke is not required.
en.aftermath: If sections or fragments fall, consider contact with the floor and other sections. Fragments are not required.
scores: The visible person, blade, stalk, and support behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no cutting.
A cutting attempt is recognizable, but blade action and the key stalk response seriously disagree.
Some support, blade use, or stalk changes are plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the cut.
The main cutting action and the person, blade, and stalk responses are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual cutting is shown, and the person, blade, stalk, and visible subsequent changes are coherent without obvious anomalies.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if the person only supports the stalk or prepares the tool, or actual blade–stalk interaction is never visible.

zh.title: 用手锯锯竹竿
zh.question: 人物用手锯加工竹竿的整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察持锯手的往复运动、另一手对竹竿的控制和身体平衡，动作幅度可以不同。
zh.contact: 锯刃应在可解释的位置与竹竿接触，锯的运动与手臂动作保持连续。
zh.object: 若竹竿出现锯痕或分离，其位置与进展应与锯刃作用相关，不要求片段内完全锯断。
zh.aftermath: 若竹段或锯屑移动或落下，观察其与支撑物和地面的关系，不要求可见锯屑。
scores: 人体、锯、竹竿及支撑整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有锯切。
可辨认锯切尝试，但锯的运动与竹竿关键反应严重不符。
往复动作或竹竿变化部分合理，同时存在影响锯切的明显异常。
主要锯切及人体、锯和竹竿反应合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际锯切已呈现，人体、锯、竹竿和可见后续变化协调，没有明显异常。
zh.unknown: 仅摆放竹竿或准备锯子，或锯刃与竹竿的实际交互始终不可见时选择无法判断。

en.title: Saw a bamboo pole
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person saws a bamboo pole?
en.body: Consider the sawing hand’s back-and-forth movement, the other hand’s control of the pole, and balance. Motion range may vary.
en.contact: The blade should contact the pole at an interpretable location, and saw motion should remain continuous with arm motion.
en.object: Any visible kerf or separation should relate to the blade action and its progress. Complete separation within the clip is not required.
en.aftermath: If bamboo sections or sawdust move or fall, consider their relation to the support and ground. Visible sawdust is not required.
scores: The visible person, saw, pole, and support behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no sawing.
A sawing attempt is recognizable, but saw movement and the key bamboo response seriously disagree.
Some back-and-forth action or bamboo changes are plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the sawing.
The main sawing action and person, saw, and bamboo responses are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual sawing is shown, and the person, saw, bamboo, and visible subsequent changes are coherent without obvious anomalies.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if the pole or saw is only being prepared, or actual blade–bamboo interaction is never visible.

zh.title: 用小刀切绿叶
zh.question: 人物手持绿叶并用小刀切割的整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手对叶片和小刀的控制及手臂协调，允许不同握法和切割方向。
zh.contact: 刀刃与叶片的接触及相对运动应与双手操作相联系。
zh.object: 柔软叶片可弯曲或局部变形，切口或分离若可见，应与刀刃作用对应。
zh.aftermath: 若叶片或切下的部分移动、落在竹席上，观察其运动与支撑关系，不要求切下特定数量。
scores: 人体、刀和叶片的可见过程整体严重不合理，或画面清楚显示没有切割。
可辨认切割尝试，但刀的作用与叶片关键反应严重不符。
双手控制或叶片变化部分合理，同时有影响切割的明显异常。
主要切割及人体、刀和叶片反应合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际切割已呈现，双手、刀、叶片及可见后续变化协调，没有明显异常。
zh.unknown: 仅持叶准备，或刀刃与叶片的实际交互始终不可见时选择无法判断。

en.title: Cut a green leaf with a small knife
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person holds and cuts a green leaf with a small knife?
en.body: Consider both hands’ control of the leaf and knife and coordination of the arms. Different grips and cutting directions are possible.
en.contact: Blade–leaf contact and relative motion should relate to the actions of the hands.
en.object: The flexible leaf may bend or deform locally. Any visible cut or separation should correspond to the blade action.
en.aftermath: If the leaf or cut portions move or fall onto the bamboo mat, consider their motion and support. No fixed number of pieces is required.
